short_description: A complete members experience with invitations, directory, messaging, announcements, events, availability, bulk email, and REST APIs.

sections.description: The members plugin adds a private member area to the StageKitWP site, including role-based access, member profiles, announcements, events, and producer tools.
sections.installation: Upload the stagekitwp-members plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/, activate it, and ensure StageKitWP Core is active as a dependency.
sections.changelog: See CHANGELOG.md for the full release history.

author: StageKitWP
